title: Project Context
description: Read repository markdown in configured specs, docs and insights directories at any depth.
limits: Limits: 64 attachments per agent or Skill, 65,536 bytes per document, 2,000 discovered documents, 32,000 scanned entries and 40 directory levels. Reviews include whole documents up to 8,000 estimated tokens after wrapping; skipped files are recorded in the trace.
summary: {count} listed documents · {tokens} estimated tokens in document contents
unavailable: Repository clone unavailable. No documents were scanned.
limited: Partial scan. Limits or unreadable entries prevented a complete listing:
empty: No markdown documents found under configured context directories.
noMatches: No paths match this search. Your attachments are unchanged.
previewError: This document is missing, unreadable, unsafe or too large to preview.
readOnly: Read-only preview. Each review reads a fresh snapshot.
selection: {count}/64 attached · ≈ {estimate} content tokens for the selected repository
unknownEstimate: Some selected paths have unknown estimates.
estimateNotice: Content estimates exclude source labels and wrapping. The runtime trace measures the actual guarded block, separately from provider usage.
agentInheritance: Agent documents run first, then documents from enabled loaded Skills in saved Skill order. The current repository is used and duplicate paths appear once.
skillInheritance: These documents are inherited by agents only when this Skill is enabled, linked and loaded. Only attachments for the review's repository are included.
localOnly: Local filesystem attachments are not included in CI exports. CI does not receive this local context.
saved: Context saved. Body and config versions are unchanged.
saveError: Could not save context. Check repository access and whether each document still exists and is safe. Your selection is retained.
